question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The incorrectly spelt word is '**Neutrelise**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given options, the incorrectly spelt word is '**Neutrelise**'. • Its correct spelling is '**Neutralise**'. • It means 'to take away the effect of something'. (किसी वस्‍तु को निष्‍प्रभावी कर देना) • *Example: to **neutralize** a threat...* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Nineteen**: 19. (उन्‍नीस) • **Noun**: a word that is the name of a thing, an idea, a place, or a person. (वस्‍तु, विचार, स्‍थान या व्‍यक्ति के नाम का सूचक शब्‍द; संज्ञा) • **Nationalise**: to put a company or organization under the control of the government. [किसी कंपनी या संगठन का राष्‍ट्रीयकरण करना (उसे सरकारी नियंत्रण में लेना)] 33:T5fd, The correct answer is **'Ultimately'.**
